curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With only one week to decide what defines a lifetime, how does anyone choose the single moment they want to carry into forever?
curatedMovie.description: At a quiet social services waystation, counselors guide the newly deceased through personal interviews to help each person select just one defining memory to keep for eternity.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate, gentle, and contemplative; a reflective drama ideal for attentive solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This drama-fantasy centers a quietly unusual office where counselors help the recently deceased choose one memory to keep.
